CustomField.description: If lead is included in User's Region based on the Referrer (FinServ__ReferredByUser__c) instead of Owner
CustomField.formula: AND( OR( $User.Area_Code__c == FinServ__ReferredByUser__r.Area_Code__c, AND( CONTAINS($UserRole.Name, 'Head'), $User.State_Code__c == FinServ__ReferredByUser__r.State_Code__c ), CONTAINS($UserRole.Name, 'General Manager') ), TEXT($User.Commercial_Segment__c) == TEXT(FinServ__ReferredByUser__r.Commercial_Segment__c) )
CustomField.label: Referrer Region Flag
